description:
Amendment 0004 is issued to inform all offerors to the following information:

Proposal Due Date for the Triennial Electrical Inspection Procurement at Columbus VAACC has been extended.

The new Proposal Due Date is May 28, 2026, 10:00 A.M. EST.  Proposals shall be submitted to Brian Kish;

Email:  Brian.Kish@va.gov

All otherTerms and Conditions remain unchanged.
